title: DeviceRegistryEntry
description: Server-side record per registered client (device registry). Identity is minted at PIN onboarding; desired_state is the server-held reconciliation target returned on every heartbeat, and the agent converges to it — the control-path mirror of report-compare. Liveness is derived from last_heartbeat vs timeout, not stored.

display_name.description: Operator-assigned label (e.g. 'Lab-PC-3'); metadata, editable without breaking hardware linkage. Empty/'pending' devices display by pin.

machine_model.description: From last manifest; drives factory model-match.

desired_state.description: Reconciliation target pushed in the heartbeat ack. While downed, the agent displays the out-of-service wallpaper (re-applied on logon) — visual status only, no session lock. Mechanics are Phase 4.

downed_content_id.description: Content Library wallpaper displayed while this machine is downed; null = venue default downed wallpaper.

downed_reason.description: Operator note (maintenance, reserved, event staging); shown on the dashboard.

wu_status.description: Last Windows Update poll outcome reported by this agent (timed interval or operator-requested scan_updates directive); null = never polled.

wu_pending.description: Non-installed WUA updates at last poll; the dashboard state pill goes yellow and pulses when > 0.

wu_scan_unix.description: Unix seconds of the last Windows Update poll.

wu_install_state.description: In-flight/last Windows Update INSTALL run (T33 install_updates directive); null = this agent never ran an install.

wu_install_done.description: Updates installed so far in the current/last install run — the dashboard pill streams done/total.

wu_install_total.description: Pending updates found at install start (the denominator).

wu_install_error.description: Per-update WUA failure detail when install_state = failed; null otherwise.

wu_reboot_pending.description: True only when WUA's own verdict said a reboot is required and the agent armed one (operator decision: never reboot unless demanded).

wu_auto_downed.description: The install request auto-downed this station (T33); the terminal install transition restores active. An operator-owned down never sets this flag.

wp_drift.description: True while the desktop's wallpaper file no longer hashes to the enforced target (venue wallpaper or downed image); the dashboard actions column shows a yellow pulsing sync pill.

wp_expected_sha.description: sha256 of the enforced wallpaper image recorded at apply time; null = nothing enforced.

wp_actual_sha.description: sha256 of the image the desktop currently references; null = unreadable/missing.
